findings.issue: "Prefer mocking the database layer in tests" directly contradicts the Testing section's "run against real Postgres / Redis via Testcontainers. Don't mock the DB layer." An agent cannot satisfy both.
findings.recommendation: Delete the mocking line from General guidance; the Testing section already states the intended policy.

findings.issue: The section restates seven rules verbatim from earlier sections, adding no new information and creating a second copy that can drift.
findings.recommendation: Delete the entire "Important reminders" section; each rule already lives under its topical heading.

findings.issue: "Write clean, maintainable code and follow industry best practices" and "organize modules logically" are unexecutable platitudes — every model already attempts this, so the lines only add noise.
findings.recommendation: Remove the two platitude bullets; keep only rules that change agent behavior, as the rest of the file does.

findings.issue: No build/run/test commands (how to run the Testcontainers suite, lint, typecheck) and no git/PR conventions, so an agent must guess the verification workflow.
findings.recommendation: Add a short Commands section (test, lint, typecheck, dev server) and a line on branch/commit conventions or a pointer to where they live.

findings.issue: "TypeScript strict, plus exactOptionalPropertyTypes" doesn't say where this is enforced or what to do in a repo where it is off (enable it vs. conform to existing config), leaving the agent to guess against the "match the repo" rule above it.
findings.recommendation: State the intent explicitly, e.g. "tsconfig must set strict and exactOptionalPropertyTypes; enable them if missing in repos this guide owns."
